name: MKI Password Policy
overview: Password rules and forced password changes for Jellyfin users.
description: Enforces password rules (length, character types, no username, common passwords) on the server for every client, with ready-made profiles. Lets an administrator require a new password from all users or from single users, right away or with a notice period: they cannot sign in on any device until they have set one. Accounts without a password are locked until they get a temporary password. Web-based apps show a popup users must answer; TVs get Jellyfin's message window and a change page that opens in any browser.
changelog: Accounts without a password that have a profile or a request are now locked right away on every sign-in path (apps, TVs, Quick Connect, existing sessions), with no notice period, and nobody can claim them by name: new Temporary password button shows a random password once and the user replaces it at the next sign-in. Passwords an administrator sets (Jellyfin's Password tab or new users) and reset PINs now count as temporary for users with a profile. A second request can only bring a deadline forward. Bulk requests never include the admin who sends them. Web-based apps show a popup that must be answered during a notice period; TVs get Jellyfin's message window instead of a fading toast. Settings page: every change applies immediately, no Save button, with a question before anything locks accounts.
